title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Commercialization
Senior Technical Program Manager, Partner Trip Platform
Technical Program Manager
description_html:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.



About the Team

Decagon’s APM team turns enterprise commitments into durable customer outcomes. We own deployment execution, steady-state operations, and the operating system that lets delivery quality and velocity scale as our customer base and deal complexity grow.

Within the APM team, the Technical Program Manager (TPM) function helps drive end-to-end delivery of Decagon's most complex customer implementations — design partnerships, strategic deals, and enterprise go-lives — alongside the internal cross-functional programs that underpin enterprise readiness. We work across the company to ensure every deployment ships on time and at high quality. Most importantly, the TPM function builds the operational strategy and foundation that scales as Decagon grows.

This is a fully in-office role based in our New York office.


About the Role

As a Technical Program Manager at Decagon, you will own delivery of our most complex customer deployments and drive the internal cross-functional programs that enable enterprise readiness. You will work across APM, Engineering, Product, Research, Security, Legal, and Go-to-Market to translate requirements into executable programs, manage dependencies across parallel workstreams, and surface issues before they become blockers. As Decagon grows, you will be responsible for continuously improving our operational and internal functional excellence so we can scale seamlessly.



In this role, you will:

 - Partner with a forward-deployed working team to drive operational excellence and program management for complex customer implementations end-to-end — aligning on scope, sequencing dependencies, managing risk, and ensuring no one is caught off-guard at handoffs or milestones; this includes design partnerships and strategic accounts where requirements are still taking shape

 - Translate customer requirements and feedback into structured program plans — working with GTM and Product to prioritize the highest-impact asks, map them to delivery roadmaps, and track execution against committed timelines

 - Drive internal cross-functional programs — model lifecycle management, security and compliance buildouts, external certifications — from kickoff through completion, aligning stakeholders and holding workstreams accountable without direct authority over executing teams



Your background looks something like this

 - 4-6+ years of experience as a technical program manager or in product/engineering operations, with direct ownership of either complex enterprise deployments or large-scale internal cross-functional initiatives

 - Track record running high-stakes customer implementations or feature builds at the design-partner or strategic-deal tier, where scope is ambiguous, requirements evolve mid-build, and the customer's success is tied directly to yours

 - Demonstrated ability to drive programs without authority — an outcome-oriented but collaborative approach that unites teams around shared milestones and holds the work accountable end-to-end with influence

 - Structured, rigorous approach to ambiguity — able to define program scope, sequence dependencies, surface blockers early, and keep multiple concurrent workstreams moving without losing resolution

 - Enough technical fluency to engage credibly with engineering teams — able to ask the right questions, pressure-test tradeoffs, and translate between technical and business contexts without going deep on implementation

 - Exceptional written and verbal communicator — able to calibrate depth, format, and framing for customers, engineering leads, executive sponsors, and external partners alike



Even better if you have

 - Hands-on experience with LLMs or conversational AI — you've shipped something with these systems, whether in a professional or personal context

 - A track record of moving programs through legal, security, engineering, and customer approval gates — able to anticipate friction points and keep timelines intact



Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

 - Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

 - Parental Leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

 - Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

 - Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.
$160K – $200K • Offers Equity

title: Technical Program Manager, Fraud Technology
description_html: The  Technical Program Manager  is responsible for coordinating and supporting technology delivery, governance processes, and cross-functional execution for strategic Fraud Technology initiatives. In this role, you will partner with engineering teams, product stakeholders, platform teams, and risk/compliance partners to support successful program execution, effective dependency management, and alignment with established technology standards. You will utilize strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills to guide programs from planning through implementation and release. This position requires an understanding of how technology teams and business functions work together, as well as the ability to coordinate across diverse groups to achieve shared program objectives.    Key Responsibilities    End-to-End Program Delivery & Roadmap Execution    Support technology planning, execution, and delivery governance activities across programs within Citi's Fraud Technology portfolio.  Track and monitor program milestones, deliverables, critical paths, and dependencies across multiple agile teams and hybrid technology environments.  Proactively manage cross-program dependencies, identifying delivery risks, technical bottlenecks, and resource constraints while partnering with stakeholders to develop mitigation plans.  Support release planning activities, operational readiness reviews, and deployment coordination to help ensure successful production implementations.  Monitor program health, escalate issues as appropriate, and provide delivery transparency through effective reporting and governance processes.    Architecture Alignment, Dependency Management & Systems Integration    Facilitate discussions among stakeholders and engineering teams regarding delivery impacts, dependencies, priorities, and implementation considerations.  Coordinate architecture review activities and support alignment across participating technology teams.  Develop and leverage working knowledge of modern software architecture concepts, including microservices, APIs, cloud technologies, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems to effectively support program delivery.  Assist with coordination of system integration activities and technology dependency management across multiple delivery teams.    AI-Augmented Program Management & Operational Excellence    Champion the use of Generative AI (GenAI) and automation tools to improve program management efficiency and consistency.  Leverage AI-enabled solutions to automate meeting summaries, action-item tracking, technical documentation, and Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).  Support generation of status reporting, release communications, dashboard metrics, and milestone tracking.  Promote adoption of AI-driven delivery practices, templates, and reporting standards across participating teams.    Stakeholder Communication    Partner with engineering teams and business stakeholders to communicate delivery progress, key milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies.  Build collaborative relationships across technology and business teams to facilitate effective decision-making and issue resolution.  Prepare and deliver program status updates for governance forums and leadership reviews.  Work collaboratively with business units, external technology vendors, operations teams, internal audit partners, and technology stakeholders to support successful delivery outcomes.    Risk, Governance & Control Management    Track and report program risks, issues, dependencies, and governance concerns while partnering with stakeholders on mitigation plans.  Ensure adherence to Citi's Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) requirements, architecture review processes, data governance standards, and applicable regulatory obligations.  Support change management, release management, and operational governance processes.  Assist in maintaining audit readiness and documentation required for internal and external reviews.     Qualifications & Competencies    Experience & Domain Expertise    5-8 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Project Management, Technology Delivery, or a related discipline.  Experience working within Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery environments.  Technical familiarity with modern architecture patterns, including microservices, REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven platforms, cloud technologies, and distributed systems.  Experience coordinating cross-functional technology initiatives and managing dependencies across multiple teams and stakeholders.  Prior experience in financial services, payments, fraud prevention, risk technology, or a related domain is preferred.    Project Management & AI Tooling    PMP and/or PMI-ACP certification preferred.  Additional certifications such as CSM, SAFe, Cloud Practitioner, or PMI-CPMAI are advantageous.  Experience utilizing Jira, Confluence, Jira Align, MS Project, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise collaboration and delivery platforms.  Experience leveraging GenAI tools such as Copilot and enterprise AI solutions to improve reporting, planning, documentation, and communication activities.    Leadership & Communication    Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships and coordinate activities across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.  Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.  Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.  Ability to operate effectively within a highly matrixed environment and influence outcomes through partnership and collaboration.     Education    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.     Other Relevant Skills    Delivery Management  Project Management  Stakeholder Management  Risk & Issue Management  Program Governance  Agile Delivery  Technology Coordination  Executive Reporting      •Working Environment: office setting, minimal travel required. • Effort: minimal physical effort required.               ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Technology Project Management            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Irving Texas United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $96,400.00 - $144,600.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. title: Senior Security Engineer, Device
location: San Francisco, California, United States of America
description_html: Senior Security Engineer, Device    Description -    Software Engineer, Device Security    San Francisco, CA      Who We Are       HP IQ is HP’s new AI innovation lab. Combining startup agility with HP’s global scale, we’re building intelligent technologies that redefine how the world works, creates, and collaborates.      We’re assembling a diverse, world-class team—engineers, designers, researchers, and product minds—focused on creating an intelligent ecosystem across HP’s portfolio. Together, we’re developing intuitive, adaptive solutions that spark creativity, boost productivity, and make collaboration seamless.      We create breakthrough solutions that make complex tasks feel effortless, teamwork more natural, and ideas more impactful—always with a human-centric mindset.      By embedding AI advancements into every HP product and service, we’re expanding what’s possible for individuals, organisations, and the future of work.      Join us as we reinvent work, so people everywhere can do their best work.      About the Role      As a    Software Engineer specializing in Device Security   , you will contribute to building secure, privacy-focused technologies for HP IQ's next generation of AI-enabled devices. You’ll work alongside experienced security, firmware, operating system, hardware, and cloud engineers to help protect customer data and strengthen the security of our products.      In this role, you’ll develop and implement security features across embedded systems, PCs, and server-class workstations. You’ll gain hands-on experience with areas such as secure boot, cryptography, device identity, secure communication, and data protection while contributing to products throughout the development lifecycle.      This is an opportunity for an engineer who has a strong foundation in software development and an interest in device security to deepen their technical expertise while working on complex, real-world security challenges.      What You Might Do       Develop and implement security features for embedded and connected devices, including secure boot, key management, encryption, device identity, and data protection.      Contribute to the design and implementation of secure software components using established security architectures and industry best practices.      Collaborate with engineers across CoreOS, Firmware, Design, Hardware, and Cloud Services to integrate security capabilities into HP IQ products.      Develop and maintain software in C, C++, Java, or related languages across embedded, AOSP, Linux, or Windows environments.      Contribute to TrustZone, TEE, kernel-level, or other hardware-backed security applications with guidance from experienced engineers.      Help implement secure communication channels between devices and services while protecting sensitive and personal data.      Work with biometric sensors and other hardware components to support secure data flows across device boundaries.      Participate in threat modeling, security reviews, vulnerability analysis, testing, and remediation activities.      Apply secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices throughout the development process.      Investigate security issues, troubleshoot software and system-level problems, and contribute to solutions that improve product security and reliability.       Essential Qualifications       Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.      Typically 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience, including experience with embedded systems, operating systems, firmware, or security-related development.      Programming experience in C, C++, Java, or a similar systems programming language.      Foundational understanding of software and device security concepts such as secure boot, cryptography, authentication, access control, PKI, or application sandboxing.      Experience developing or debugging software in embedded, Linux, AOSP, Windows, or similar environments.      Understanding of software development fundamentals, including debugging, testing, code reviews, source control, and software development lifecycle practices.      Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional partners to solve technical problems.      Strong interest in developing deeper expertise in device security, cryptography, privacy, and secure systems.       Preferred Skills       Experience or coursework involving embedded systems, consumer electronics, IoT, operating systems, firmware, or device security.      Familiarity with AOSP or Linux security technologies such as TrustZone, TEE, Android Verified Boot (AVB), Keystore, or SELinux.      Familiarity with common cryptographic concepts, authentication mechanisms, certificates, or PKI.      Exposure to hardware-backed security, secure elements, TPMs, biometric systems, or trusted execution environments.      Experience with security testing, vulnerability analysis, threat modeling, or secure coding practices.      Familiarity with privacy and security frameworks or standards such as GDPR, CCPA, or ISO.      Curiosity and a desire to continue developing expertise in security, privacy, embedded systems, and emerging technologies.
